title: ThemeStyleContent extensions — post-v0.2.0 engine keys
$comment: The published Zed theme schema (zed-v0.2.0.json, byte-identical to https://zed.dev/schema/themes/v0.2.0.json as of 2026-08-05) is frozen at its 2024 shape while the Zed engine accepts ~47 newer style keys. This file registers ONLY the post-freeze keys this theme actually emits. tests/schema.test.ts asserts every emitted style key exists in the vendored schema OR here — closing the typo hole the open published schema leaves (it has no additionalProperties:false, so plain validation passes any key). npm run validate deliberately still targets the vendored schema: composing this file into validation would change no outcome. Do NOT add deprecated keys here — the test's ratchet list must stay out of both files. Provenance: zed-industries/zed crates/settings_content/src/theme.rs, verified against main 2026-08-05; per-key-group PR numbers in docs/audits/2026-08-05-theme-json-audit.md.
